meta.name: understand-domain
meta.description: Extract business domain knowledge from a codebase and generate an interactive domain flow graph. Works standalone (lightweight scan) or derives from an existing /understand knowledge graph.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从代码库提取业务领域知识并生成交互式流程图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从现有代码中梳理业务逻辑和领域模型
copy.tagline_en: Extract business domain knowledge from codebase and generate interactive flow graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extract business logic and domain models from existing code

howto.what: 从当前代码库提取业务领域知识(领域、业务流程、步骤),生成可交互的横向流程图并在仪表盘展示;若已存在知识图谱则直接推导,不重新扫描文件。
howto.when: 当你运行 /understand-domain 想梳理项目业务领域时触发。已有知识图谱就从中推导,没有则做轻量扫描;加 --full 可强制重新扫描。

say.text: /understand-domain 从当前项目提取业务领域和流程
say.note: 生成 domain-graph.json 并自动打开仪表盘
已有知识图谱时也重新扫描一遍

say.text: 生成的领域流程图在哪里看?
say.note: 会触发仪表盘,默认显示领域视图

howto.what_en: Extracts business domain knowledge (domains, flows, process steps) from your codebase and produces an interactive horizontal flow graph in the dashboard; if a knowledge graph exists, it derives from it instead of scanning files.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you run /understand-domain to map a project's business domains. If a knowledge graph exists it derives from it; otherwise a lightweight scan runs. Use --full to force a fresh scan.

say_en.text: /understand-domain extract the business domains and flows from this project
say_en.note: Writes domain-graph.json and opens the dashboard

say_en.text: /understand-domain --full force a fresh scan of the codebase
say_en.note: Re-scans even if a knowledge graph already exists

say_en.text: Where can I view the generated domain flow graph?
say_en.note: Triggers the dashboard, showing the domain view by default
